title: Uddan-Performance-Nasha Mukt Bharat - Co-Hosted
summary: The 22nd Interact District Conference was held on Friday, 9 October 2026, at Deenanath Mangeshkar Auditorium, Vile Parle East.
description: The 22nd Interact District Conference was held on Friday, 9 October 2026, at Deenanath Mangeshkar Auditorium, Vile Parle East. Around 500 Interactors, 50 Rotaractors and 40 Rotarians came together to celebrate youth leadership, creativity, talent and service. The Rotary Club of Mumbai Parleshwar was proud to be Platinum Host and an active participant. The conference spotlighted the Nasha Mukt Bharat campaign through competitions raising awareness about substance abuse and promoting a healthy, addiction-free life. Participants took a pledge to stay free from addiction, followed by an award ceremony honouring contributors. RCMP’s Interact Clubs turned out in strength: about 90 students and 10 teachers and parents from Madhavrao Bhagwat High School and Airport High School (Art), GMES (Drawing) and Anandi Special School (Dance). GMES won four prizes, while Madhavrao Bhagwat High School won one prize plus the first prize trophy for highest participation.
location: Mumbai, Dinanath Natyagruh, Vile Parle, Maharashtra
